decisions.decision: SEC-01: full upload/download redesign (web mode only), not path-confinement
decisions.rationale: Strongest fix per SECURITY_CONCERNS.md H1 — no server-side path ever named by a web client; desktop keeps native-dialog path flow unchanged

decisions.decision: CSV import caches one upload in UserSession (session_store.rs), not re-uploaded per step
decisions.rationale: Avoids 3x re-upload of the same file for headers/preview/commit; reuses existing per-session struct instead of a new store

decisions.decision: restore_backup also becomes a client upload, no path parameter
SEC-02 login/register throttle: new in-process store beside session_store.rs, keyed by username AND IP independently
decisions.rationale: No registry.db schema change needed; both keys catch both targeted-account and single-attacker-many-accounts brute force

decisions.decision: Lockout shape: 5 fails -> lock for base window W; each repeated lockout cycle doubles W; resets to base on next successful login
decisions.rationale: User-specified exact shape, not a menu pick — must be implemented exactly as stated, not substituted with a different backoff curve

decisions.decision: Argon2 concurrency cap: try_acquire + HTTP 429 (no queueing), 2-4 shared permits across login/register/export_csv(password mode)
decisions.rationale: 429 chosen over queueing specifically for DoS resistance (a queue itself could become a pile-up vector)
User chose forgiving UX over a bare error message

decisions.decision: CSP: strict default-src/script-src/style-src 'self', no unsafe-inline; same policy in web-src-tauri response header AND tauri.conf.json app.security.csp (replacing null); relaxed only in Vite dev mode; also add Referrer-Policy + X-Frame-Options: DENY
decisions.rationale: Matches SECURITY_CONCERNS.md M3 fix suggestion; confirmed the one existing inline style (PasswordGeneratorPanel.tsx:186) is a DOM property set, not parsed CSS text, so style-src 'self' is safe
